Blanket Zeroize invokes arbitrary DefaultIsZeroes behavior and volatile replacement/fence; a pure returned value is insufficient.

host_work.map may schedule parallel workers and invoke arbitrary callbacks; native scheduling, allocation and effects cannot be replaced by pure output equality.
